PRESS STATEMENT ON THE POLIO VACCINATION CAMPAIGN

From October 2-6, 2024, the Ministry of Health vaccinated 3,712,323 children under ten across nine counties, following the detection of poliovirus in parts of Kenya and Uganda. https://t.co/QuaxSQzO0c

The 5-day vaccination campaign against #polio will focus on 9 high risk counties: 
Busia, Bungoma, Trans-Nzoia, West Pokot and Turkana, Nairobi, Kiambu (Kabete, kikuyu,kiambaa, Kiambu town, Juja, Ruiru and Thika), Kajiado(Kajiado east and north in Kajiado) and Machakos https://t.co/2TyjJr5I8f
